# Abdullah Ayyash

> Abdullah Ayyash is a full stack developer who builds web apps with JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express.js and Laravel. This site is his portfolio: skills, projects and a contact form.

Canonical site: https://abdullahayyash.ca/

Skills:
- Frontend: React, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, Laravel, PHP, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
- Tools and technologies: Git, GitHub, Docker, REST APIs, command line

## Main pages

- [Home](https://abdullahayyash.ca/): Introduction, technical skills and all projects
- [Contact](https://abdullahayyash.ca/contact.html): Contact form for web app, website or API project enquiries

## Featured projects

- [Prime Takeoffs](https://stage.primetakeoffs.com/): Construction takeoff and estimation platform for linear and area measurements on blueprint PDFs. Built with Laravel, React, PHP, Docker and Python.
- [SwiftLead](https://swiftlead.app/): Lead management and performance optimization platform for multi-site pipeline tracking. Built with Laravel 12, React 19, Inertia.js and PostgreSQL.

## Open-source and practice projects

- [AutoSave Feedback Pro](https://abdullah-ayyash.github.io/auto-save-feedback/demo/): Modular feedback system for web applications (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript). Source: https://github.com/abdullah-ayyash/auto-save-feedback
- [Robust Toast Notifications](https://abdullah-ayyash.github.io/robust-toast-notifications/): Production-ready notification system with validation, duplicate prevention and automatic cleanup (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap 5.3). Source: https://github.com/abdullah-ayyash/robust-toast-notifications
- [ShopNex](https://github.com/abdullah-ayyash/eShopify-Online-Store): Online store web application built with the PERN stack (PostgreSQL, Express, React, Node.js).
- [Jammming](https://spotify-cc.surge.sh/): React app that searches the Spotify library and saves custom playlists to a Spotify account. Source: https://github.com/abdullah-ayyash/jamming-spotify-api
- [Responsive Chess Club Website](https://abdullah-ayyash.github.io/responsive-club-website/): Static, responsive HTML and CSS website for a chess club. Source: https://github.com/abdullah-ayyash/responsive-club-website
- [B-Choice App Business Website](https://abdullah-ayyash.github.io/flexbox-business-site-starting/): Business website for a mobile app that offers alternatives to popular phone apps (HTML, CSS). Source: https://github.com/abdullah-ayyash/flexbox-business-site-starting
- [Credit Card Checker](https://github.com/abdullah-ayyash/credit-card-checker): JavaScript credit card validator using the Luhn algorithm.
- [DNA Simulation](https://github.com/abdullah-ayyash/Pila-Aequor-Organism): JavaScript simulation of DNA and mutation speed in a living system.
